summary: Open massive spatial-element files — LiDAR point clouds and block models, tens of millions of elements — and orbit / filter / section / pick / measure against the source. Streaming, no import step, offline.

executes.workers: blob compute workers (winding containment sweeps) — inherit this document CSP: connect-src none applies inside them

reach.network: none — the verified micro.html artifact (this file) makes zero network requests; connect-src 'none' enforces it

hosted_pwa.note: gentropic.org/micro wraps this artifact in a PWA shell (index.html + a service worker) that is OUTSIDE this sealed file. The SW runs in its own context (not bound by the page's connect-src) and fetches ONLY same-origin app assets (offline shell cache) + an update check ('is there a newer build?'). It never accesses opened file data — that stays in the page's memory, never handed to the SW — so data confidentiality is unaffected. For provable zero-network, run this downloaded micro.html from file:// (no SW). Update UI in the app drives the SW via postMessage, not a page fetch, so connect-src none still holds.
hosted_pwa.network: same-origin app assets + update check only

filesystem.writes: user-initiated PNG export (OS Save dialog), and — on explicit Ctrl+S — project.json + copied source files INSIDE project folders you explicitly grant (File System Access, Chromium only; permission re-requested per session)
filesystem.local_state: render-budget preference in localStorage + an optional recents list (file handles + names) in IndexedDB — local only, never transmitted; reopening a recent re-grants permission (no silent re-read); clearable + disableable
